blocks.title: Galvanic (voltaic) cell
blocks.text: Woh cell jis mein chemical energy khud-ba-khud (spontaneously) exothermic redox process ke zariye electrical energy mein badalti hai; anode par oxidation aur cathode par reduction hoti hai.
Galvanic cell electrons ke khud-ba-khud transfer se faida uthane ke liye banaya jata hai. Galvanic cell ko voltaic cell bhi kehte hain. Misalein: Daniell cell aur dry cell.
Is half-equation ka electrode potential napne ke liye:
pure (khalis) copper ki rod ko Cu²⁺(aq) ions ke solution (maslan copper(II) sulfate solution) mein rakha jata hai. Is Cu²⁺/Cu system ko half-cell kehte hain.
Half-cell banane ke liye yeh standard conditions hain:

items: Cu²⁺(aq) ions ki concentration 1.00 mol dm⁻³

blocks.text: Do half-cells ko jor dein to electrochemical cell ban jata hai, aur un ke darmiyan voltage napa ja sakta hai. Figure 10.7 mein Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell ko Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell se jor kar poora electrochemical cell banaya gaya hai.
Half-cells ko in cheezon se joda jata hai:

items: taar (wires), jo har half-cell ki metal rod ko high-resistance voltmeter se jorti hain; electrons is bahar ke circuit mein zyada negative (ya kam positive) electrode potential wale metal se kam negative (ya zyada positive) wale metal ki taraf behte hain
salt bridge, jo dono half-cells ke darmiyan ions ko chalne de kar circuit poora karta hai taake ionic balance (ions ka tawazun) qaim rahe; salt bridge electrons ko nahi guzarne deta.

blocks.text: Salt bridge filter paper (ya kisi aur inert porous, yani chhote soorakhon wali, cheez) ki patti se banaya ja sakta hai jo potassium nitrate ke saturated solution mein bhigoi gayi ho.

blocks.alt: Do half-cells jo 298 K par salt bridge se jure hain. Left: Cu2+ (1 mol/dm3) mein copper rod (Cu), terminal +. Right: Zn2+ (1 mol/dm3) mein zinc rod (Zn), terminal -. Rods taaron se high resistance voltmeter se jure hain; taar par teer zinc rod se copper rod ki taraf hain aur dono ends par e- likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.7: Cu2+/Cu half-cell ko Zn2+/Zn half-cell se jor kar bana electrochemical cell (kitab ki Figure 10.7 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Zinc ka E° (−0.76 V) copper (+0.34 V) se zyada negative hai, is liye zinc negative terminal hai: zinc atoms electrons chhor kar Zn²⁺ bante hain, electrons taar se copper rod tak jate hain aur wahan Cu²⁺ ko Cu banate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 10.7 mein taar par e⁻ ke teer copper (+) se zinc (−) ki taraf bane hain. Electrons zinc (negative) se copper (positive) ki taraf behte hain, is liye upar ke diagram mein teer sahi direction mein hain.
Figure 10.7 ke half-cells ke voltages in half-equations se dikhaye jate hain:

Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell ko Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell se jorne par electrochemical cell banta hai. Voltages ka muqabla batata hai ke Zn²⁺ ions Cu²⁺ ions se mushkil se reduce hote hain. Is cell ka voltage +1.10 V hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan formula E°cell = E°red + E°oxi likhti hai magar hisab mein (+0.34) − (−0.76) karti hai. Dono ka jawab ek hai: agar zinc ka oxidation potential (+0.76 V) jama karein ya us ka reduction potential (−0.76 V) ghatayen, result (nateeja) +1.10 V hi aata hai. Asaan rule: E°cell = E°(cathode) − E°(anode), dono reduction potentials.
Cu-Zn galvanic cell mein zinc (Zn) anode hai aur solution ke copper ions (Cu²⁺) cathode ka kaam karte hain.
Anode par zinc oxidize hota hai aur electrons kho kar zinc ions banata hai:
Yeh electrons bahar ke circuit se cathode tak jate hain, jahan copper ions electrons le kar reduce hote hain aur copper metal banta hai:
Is tarah redox reaction ki chemical energy electrical energy mein badal jati hai, jis se kaam liya ja sakta hai.

blocks.caption: Cu-Zn galvanic cell
rows: electrons Zn se Cu ki taraf

blocks.prompt: Cu-Zn cell mein zinc rod ki mass aur copper rod ki mass ke saath waqt guzarne par kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Zinc rod oxidize ho kar Zn²⁺ ban kar solution mein jati hai, is liye us ki mass kam hoti hai. Cu²⁺ ions copper ban kar copper rod par jamte hain, is liye us ki mass barhti hai.

items: Galvanic (voltaic) cell: spontaneous redox se electrical energy; anode par oxidation, cathode par reduction.
Cu-Zn cell: Zn anode (−), Cu cathode (+), electrons taar se Zn se Cu; salt bridge (KNO₃) ions le jata hai.
